editorial:
Imagine living in an apartment building where you can hear everything through the walls. You start noticing weird sounds and strange behaviors from your neighbors, and soon you are convinced a serial killer is living right next door. You follow a young woman who gets caught in a terrifying game of cat and mouse. As she tries to figure out who the killer is, she starts doubting everyone around her. Even her current boyfriend and her ex-girlfriend start looking suspicious. It creates a really tense mood where you never know who to trust, making you feel like someone is always watching from the shadows.

The acting is solid and the way the story builds up the mystery keeps you guessing until the end. While the pacing slows down a bit in the middle, the scary moments and the twists make up for it. If you love psychological thrillers that mess with your head, you should definitely check this one out.
endingExplained: The big twist reveals that the person you least expect is actually the killer. After a lot of pointing fingers at the boyfriend and the ex, the truth comes out in a shocking final confrontation. The main character discovers that her suspicions were right all along, but she was looking at the wrong people. The movie ends with a violent struggle where she has to fight for her life to escape the apartment building alive.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves twisty mysteries and creepy neighbor stories.
